final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code to make the test suite pass and ensure the functions behave as their docstrings specify:

- In bookings/billing.py, I corrected billable_blocks to raise ValueError for negative minutes and to always round up partial blocks instead of using round().
- In bookings/schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument by changing slots=[] to slots=None and creating a new list inside the function.
- In bookings/timeutil.py, I improved parse_duration to support all the documented formats (e.g., "1h30m", "2h", "45m", "1:30", "45") and to raise ValueError only if none match.

No changes were made to tests or other files.
